senses.sense_definition: A light ring or frame suspended from each side of a horse's saddle, used to support the rider's foot while mounting or riding.

examples.text: She placed her left foot firmly in the <w>stirrup</w> and swung herself up onto the saddle.
Before starting the trail ride, the instructor helped adjust each <w>stirrup</w> to the proper length.

senses.sense_definition: The stapes bone in the middle ear, which resembles an equestrian stirrup.

examples.text: Vibrations pass through the hammer and anvil before reaching the <w>stirrup</w> bone in the inner ear.
The surgeon carefully examined the damage to the tiny <w>stirrup</w> during the middle ear operation.

senses.sense_definition: A piece or device shaped like a saddle stirrup, used as a support, clamp, or holder.

examples.text: The patient rested both feet in a metal <w>stirrup</w> on either side of the examination table.
The pipe was secured to the ceiling joist using a heavy steel <w>stirrup</w>.

senses.sense_definition: A portable, flexible ladder-like loop of webbing used in aid climbing to support a climber's foot.

examples.text: He clipped the nylon <w>stirrup</w> into the bolt and carefully stepped into the webbing loops.
Aid climbers rely on each <w>stirrup</w> to stand up and place protection on steep rock faces.

senses.sense_definition: A closed loop of reinforcing bar used in concrete structures to resist shear and diagonal tension stresses.

examples.text: The structural engineer checked that every steel <w>stirrup</w> was placed at the correct spacing along the beam.
Adding a vertical <w>stirrup</w> prevents dangerous diagonal cracks from forming in the concrete column.

senses.sense_definition: A short rope hanging from a yardarm with an eye at the lower end to support a footrope.

examples.text: The sailor clung to the yard while standing on the rope supported by a thick <w>stirrup</w>.
Before setting sail, the crew inspected each <w>stirrup</w> along the main yardarm for wear.

senses.sense_definition: Describing trousers or leggings that have a strap passing under the arch of the foot to hold them in place.

examples.text: She wore tight black <w>stirrup</w> pants that tucked smoothly into her winter boots.
Popular in the eighties, <w>stirrup</w> leggings have recently made a modest return to fashion runways.

senses.sense_definition: An English surname originating from an occupation or nickname.

examples.text: Mr. <w>Stirrup</w> was invited to speak about his family history at the local heritage society.
The award was presented to Doctor <w>Stirrup</w> for his significant contributions to community health.
